projects.title: WP Hub
projects.tagline: Internal dashboard for managing 500+ WordPress sites.
projects.summary: A custom-built multi-site management hub to monitor, update, and maintain a large fleet of WordPress sites from a single interface replacing manual per-site work with centralised ops.

sections.heading: context
sections.body: Managing 500+ WordPress sites manually was unsustainable. Each site needed updates, monitoring, and quick-access admin doing this one-by-one was hours of overhead daily.

sections.heading: approach
sections.body: Built a centralised dashboard that aggregates all sites via the WP REST API. One login to see plugin/theme update status, server health, last-login activity, and quick-jump links to any admin panel.

sections.heading: outcome
sections.body: Reduced multi-site maintenance overhead by ~80%. Updates that used to take half a day now run in minutes from a single screen.

projects.title: Early Bird College
projects.summary: A fully custom WordPress-powered dashboard for Early Bird College handling student applications, tracking progress, and managing enrolments through a bespoke plugin and UI.

sections.heading: context
sections.body: The client needed a centralised place to manage student enrolments and track application progress existing plugins couldn't handle their specific workflow.

sections.heading: approach
sections.body: WordPress handles the student-facing frontend data collection forms, user accounts, and content. Django runs the backend: payment processing, enrolment logic, and the iframe management layer that ties both systems together.

sections.heading: outcome
sections.body: Replaced a manual spreadsheet-based process with a live dashboard saving staff hours per week and reducing enrolment errors.

projects.title: ITBS Business Tracking
projects.tagline: Custom business tracking dashboard for Identity Theft Business Solutions.
projects.summary: A bespoke business tracking dashboard built into the client's Duda site letting them manage and monitor business identity theft cases, client records, and service statuses in one place.

sections.heading: context
sections.body: The client needed a proprietary tracking system for business identity theft cases â no off-the-shelf CRM fit their specific service model.

sections.heading: approach
sections.body: The public-facing site runs on Duda. The business tracking dashboard is a separate app hosted on GitHub Pages, deployed via AWS Amplify, and connected to the client's data layer. Fully decoupled from Duda so it can evolve independently.

sections.heading: outcome
sections.body: Delivered a fully operational tracking system tailored to their workflow, replacing disconnected spreadsheets and email chains.

projects.title: Server Checker
projects.tagline: Uptime & health monitoring tool for a 500-site fleet.
projects.summary: An internal server and uptime monitoring tool built to watch over 500+ client sites alerting on downtime, SSL expiry, and server errors without relying on expensive third-party services.

sections.heading: context
sections.body: With 500+ sites under management, manual uptime checking was impossible. Third-party monitoring tools charged per-site not viable at this scale.

sections.heading: approach
sections.body: Built a lightweight checker that pings all sites on a schedule, checks SSL validity, response codes, and server health. Alerts via email/webhook on failure.

sections.heading: outcome
sections.body: Full visibility over the entire site fleet at near-zero cost. Average issue detection time dropped from hours (client complaints) to minutes (automated alert).
